The Acer Predator Helios Neo 16 packs an Intel Core i9-14900HX, NVIDIA RTX 5070 and a 2.5K display into a powerful gaming laptop that can double up as a serious productivity machine.
From AAA gaming with DLSS and ray tracing to 4K DaVinci Resolve editing, here's what I liked, what I didn't, and whether it's worth carrying around!
